data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter widget for classic web-style page number pagination.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that displays page numbers and navigation buttons (first, previous, next, last) for moving through multiple pages of content. It features extensive customization options for colors, text styling, button sizes, and spacing.
use_when: You want web-style numeric pagination instead of infinite scrolling.
You need a customizable pagination widget with direct page jumping.
avoid_when: You prefer an infinite scrolling or lazy loading list UX.
Your application relies entirely on continuous list fetching without discrete pages.
strengths: Simple to use without external package dependencies.
Highly customizable appearance including fonts, colors, sizes, and icons.
Supports responsive design and various platforms.
weaknesses: Limited to standard number pagination use cases.
Does not handle the underlying data fetching or state management logic on its own.
